'''Narkk''' is a [[goblin]] located in [[Booty Bay]] in the [[Stranglethorn Vale]] where he runs [[Nautical Needs]]. He is in truth working on the behalf of [[Garfield Sparkblast]] of the [[Bloodsail Buccaneers]] to steal weapon crates from the [[Blackwater Raiders]].<ref name="Weapons Laying About"/>
